name: Lettuce
intro: Lettuce includes heading and loose-leaf types. This garden models an expanding rosette, harvested before flowering.
observe: Small leaves build into a layered rosette. The harvest is leaves, rather than fruit as in tomatoes.
habitat: Likes fertile, moisture-retentive soil. Summer shade can help; hot, dry conditions encourage bolting.
fact: Some loose-leaf types allow repeated picking. The game currently harvests the whole plant and sows again.
